---
title: "my_penguins.qmd"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)

summary(penguins)

bills <- penguins |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    avg_length = mean(bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

glimpse(bills)

ggplot(bills, aes(x = species, y = avg_length)) + 
  geom_col()
```
